beats.text: Surpanakha fell weeping at the feet of her brother Khara, ruler of the demons in Janasthana, and begged for revenge.
Khara sent fourteen fierce warriors after Rama. Rama defeated all of them with fourteen arrows.
Then Khara and his general Dushana brought fourteen thousand demons to the forest, with chariots, elephants and weapons of every kind.
Evil omens filled the sky. Red rain fell, and jackals howled at noon. But Khara would not turn back.
Rama sent Sita and Lakshmana to a cave in the mountain. 'This fight is mine,' he said.
He faced the whole army alone, wearing armor that shone like the sun. His arrows filled the sky.
Dushana fell. Then the three-headed Trishira. Then, at last, Khara himself.
By evening, the entire army lay still. The sages came out of hiding and showered Rama with flowers.
